{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsCZJLcNM1D7WEEvxoaY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SxFdy6suJgqvJcNLeWQeKm","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/work/parse_tree.py << 'EOF'\nimport re, sys, json\n\nlines = open('/app/dataset/genealogy_trees.txt', encoding='utf-8').read().split('\\n')\ngrid = lines[5:110]\nW = max(len(r) for r in grid)\ngrid = [r.ljust(W) for r in grid]\nH = len(grid)\n\nLET = 'A-Za-zĄąĆćĘęŁłŃńÓóŚśŹźŻż'\ntoken_pat = re.compile(f'[{LET}]+(?: [{LET}]+)*')\n\n# 1) tokens\ntokens = []\nfor r, row in enumerate(grid):\n    for m in token_pat.finditer(row):\n        tokens.append([r, m.start(), m.end(), m.group()])\n\n# 2) merge tokens on consecutive rows with overlapping spans into boxes\nboxes = []  # each: dict rows->(c0,c1,text)\nused = [False]*len(tokens)\ntokens.sort()\nfor i, t in enumerate(tokens):\n    if used[i]: continue\n    grp = [t]; used[i] = True\n    frontier = t\n    for j in range(i+1, len(tokens)):\n        if used[j]: continue\n        u = tokens[j]\n        if u[0] == frontier[0]+1 and not (u[2] < frontier[1]-1 or u[1] > frontier[2]+1):\n            grp.append(u); used[j] = True; frontier = u\n        elif u[0] > frontier[0]+1:\n            break\n    boxes.append(grp)\n\nHORIZ = set('-~+')\nVERTC = set('|│/\\\\_.+')\n\ndef is_borderish(r, c0, c1):\n    if r < 0 or r >= H: return False\n    seg = grid[r][max(0,c0):c1]\n    return sum(ch in HORIZ for ch in seg) >= 2\n\nboxinfo = []\nfor grp in boxes:\n    rtop = grp[0][0]; rbot = grp[-1][0]\n    c0 = min(g[1] for g in grp); c1 = max(g[2] for g in grp)\n    name = ' '.join(g[3] for g in grp)\n    left = c0 - 2\n    # right border: look for | or │ on name rows to the right\n    right = None\n    for g in grp:\n        row = grid[g[0]]\n        for c in range(g[2], min(W, g[2]+25)):\n            ch = row[c]\n            if ch in '|│':\n                right = c if right is None else max(right, c); break\n            if ch not in ' ': break\n    if right is None: right = c1 + 2\n    # top border row: scan up to 3 rows above first name row\n    top = None\n    for r in range(rtop-1, max(-1, rtop-4), -1):\n        if is_borderish(r, left, right+1):\n            top = r; break\n    if top is None: top = rtop - 1\n    bot = None\n    for r in range(rbot+1, min(H, rbot+4)):\n        if is_borderish(r, left, right+1):\n            bot = r; break\n    if bot is None: bot = rbot + 1\n    boxinfo.append(dict(name=name, top=top, bot=bot, left=left, right=right,\n                        nrows=(rtop, rbot)))\n\nprint(f\"{len(boxinfo)} boxes detected\")\nnames = [b['name'] for b in boxinfo]\nfrom collections import Counter\ndup = [n for n, c in Counter(names).items() if c > 1]\nprint(\"duplicate names:\", dup)\nfor b in boxinfo[:10]:\n    print(b)\njson.dump(boxinfo, open('/app/work/boxes.json','w'), ensure_ascii=False)\nEOF\npython3 /app/work/parse_tree.py","description":"Parse name boxes from tree grid"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6328,"cache_read_input_tokens":38245,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":6328,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"69cc9a31-3572-4722-b8ff-c60a3d2c0498","uuid":"dce6dc08-df70-439a-82c1-2e00e6452a3f","request_id":"req_011CcsCZHYErGZsRtG5Cuv3R"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcsCoWcSRnhp5iY7cKHoy","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01H7PcNnfMasE5ByXSxtYy3d","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/work/trace.py << 'EOF'\nimport re, json\nfrom collections import Counter\n\nlines = open('/app/dataset/genealogy_trees.txt', encoding='utf-8').read().split('\\n')\ngrid = lines[5:110]\nW = max(len(r) for r in grid)\ngrid = [list(r.ljust(W)) for r in grid]\nH = len(grid)\n\nLET = 'A-Za-zĄąĆćĘęŁłŃńÓóŚśŹźŻż'\ntoken_pat = re.compile(f'[{LET}]+(?: [{LET}]+)*')\nraw = [''.join(r) for r in grid]\ntokens = []\nfor r, row in enumerate(raw):\n    for m in token_pat.finditer(row):\n        t = m.group()\n        if t == 'x':  # noise connector char\n            continue\n        tokens.append([r, m.start(), m.end(), t])\ntokens.sort()\nused = [False]*len(tokens)\ngroups = []\nfor i, t in enumerate(tokens):\n    if used[i]: continue\n    grp = [t]; used[i] = True; frontier = t\n    for j in range(i+1, len(tokens)):\n        if used[j]: continue\n        u = tokens[j]\n        if u[0] == frontier[0]+1 and not (u[2] < frontier[1]-1 or u[1] > frontier[2]+1):\n            grp.append(u); used[j] = True; frontier = u\n        elif u[0] > frontier[0]+1:\n            break\n    groups.append(grp)\n\nHORIZ = set('-~+x')\nVERT = set('|│/\\\\_.+x')\n\ndef is_borderish(r, c0, c1):\n    if r < 0 or r >= H: return False\n    seg = raw[r][max(0,c0):c1]\n    return sum(ch in HORIZ for ch in seg) >= 2\n\nboxes = []\nfor grp in groups:\n    rtop = grp[0][0]; rbot = grp[-1][0]\n    c0 = min(g[1] for g in grp); c1 = max(g[2] for g in grp)\n    name = ' '.join(g[3] for g in grp)\n    left = c0 - 2\n    right = None\n    for g in grp:\n        row = raw[g[0]]\n        for c in range(g[2], min(W, g[2]+25)):\n            ch = row[c]\n            if ch in '|│':\n                right = c if right is None else max(right, c); break\n            if ch != ' ': break\n    if right is None: right = c1 + 2\n    top = None\n    for r in range(rtop-1, max(-1, rtop-4), -1):\n        if is_borderish(r, left, right+1):\n            top = r; break\n    if top is None: top = rtop - 1\n    bot = None\n    for r in range(rbot+1, min(H, rbot+4)):\n        if is_borderish(r, left, right+1):\n            bot = r; break\n    if bot is None: bot = rbot + 1\n    boxes.append(dict(name=name, top=top, bot=bot, left=left, right=right))\n\n# mask out box rectangles so connector tracing sees only lines\nmask = [row[:] for row in grid]\nfor b in boxes:\n    for r in range(b['top'], b['bot']+1):\n        for c in range(max(0,b['left']-1), min(W, b['right']+2)):\n            mask[r][c] = ' '\nmraw = [''.join(r) for r in mask]\n\ndef rail_score(r, c):\n    \"\"\"count horizontal chars within +-6 cols on row r\"\"\"\n    if r < 0 or r >= H: return 0\n    seg = mraw[r][max(0,c-6):c+7]\n    return sum(ch in HORIZ for ch in seg)\n\ndef find_vert(r, c, spread=2):\n    \"\"\"find vertical char at row r near col c\"\"\"\n    if r < 0 or r >= H: return None\n    for d in [0,-1,1,-2,2][:1+2*spread]:\n        cc = c+d\n        if 0 <= cc < W and mask[r][cc] in VERT:\n            return cc\n    return None\n\ndef trace(r, c, dr):\n    \"\"\"follow vertical path from (r,c) in direction dr; return list of (row,col) visited\"\"\"\n    path = [(r,c)]\n    while True:\n        nxt = find_vert(r+dr, c)\n        if nxt is None:\n            nxt = find_vert(r+2*dr, c)  # gap of one row\n            if nxt is None:\n                break\n            r, c = r+2*dr, nxt\n        else:\n            r, c = r+dr, nxt\n        path.append((r,c))\n    return path\n\ndef find_rail(path, dr):\n    \"\"\"given trace path, find the first rail row encountered (scanning along path);\n       also allow rail to be 1-2 rows beyond the end of the path\"\"\"\n    for (r,c) in path[1:]:\n        if rail_score(r,c) >= 3:\n            return (r,c)\n    er, ec = path[-1]\n    for k in (1,2):\n        if rail_score(er+dr*k, ec) >= 3:\n            return (er+dr*k, ec)\n    return None\n\nresults = []\nfor i, b in enumerate(boxes):\n    # entry above top\n    entry_rail = None\n    cands = []\n    for rr in (b['top']-1, b['top']-2):\n        if rr < 0: continue\n        for c in range(max(0,b['left']-1), min(W, b['right']+2)):\n            if mask[rr][c] in VERT:\n                cands.append((rr,c))\n        if cands: break\n    for (rr,cc) in cands:\n        p = trace(rr, cc, -1)\n        rl = find_rail(p, -1)\n        if rl:\n            entry_rail = rl; break\n    # exit below bottom\n    exit_rail = None\n    ecands = []\n    for rr in (b['bot']+1, b['bot']+2):\n        if rr >= H: continue\n        for c in range(max(0,b['left']-1), min(W, b['right']+2)):\n            if mask[rr][c] in VERT:\n                ecands.append((rr,c))\n        if ecands: break\n    for (rr,cc) in ecands:\n        p = trace(rr, cc, +1)\n        rl = find_rail(p, +1)\n        if rl:\n            exit_rail = rl; break\n    results.append(dict(idx=i, name=b['name'], entry=entry_rail, exit=exit_rail,\n                        n_entry_cands=len(cands)))\n\nno_entry = [r for r in results if r['entry'] is None]\nprint(\"boxes:\", len(boxes))\nprint(\"boxes with no entry rail (root candidates):\", [(r['idx'], r['name']) for r in no_entry])\nprint(\"boxes with exit rail:\", sum(1 for r in results if r['exit']))\njson.dump(dict(boxes=boxes, results=results), open('/app/work/trace1.json','w'), ensure_ascii=False)\nEOF\npython3 /app/work/trace.py","description":"Trace entry/exit rails for every box"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":544,"cache_read_input_tokens":57604,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":544,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"69cc9a31-3572-4722-b8ff-c60a3d2c0498","uuid":"9ab6ca88-0acd-482f-92e6-f25e2bd836c2","request_id":"req_011CcsCoVo5Qh7G43tXqa7GB"}
